title: Playing behind Louis Armstrong on 'The Closing of Storyville'
summary: Leeman finally plays behind Armstrong on the CBS Storyville show and at his Corona house, where Louis plays only Bobby Hackett records.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Milt, we're getting low on tape. However, before we run out of this side, I'll have to get to Louis Armstrong. Eventually, I got to know Louis Armstrong well, such as being on the performance and closing of the Storyville Show, we were on the Timex show in Miami. He did a couple of numbers with us, the Bob Crosby Band, when I was with the Bob Crosby Band on the same show, and actually, it was the Lawson-Haggard Jazz Band -- Crosby just fronted it. Gene Krupa and Lionel Hampton did bits on that show with us.
It was exciting for me because I finally got to play behind Louis. When we did that Storyville show, the closing of Storyville, for CBS, which I told about in
great detail -- after rehearsal, Louis asked Bobby Hackett and Lou Stein and myself, we all lived on Long Island, he asked us to his house to relax in Corona.

And when we got there, he had his right hand man put on a bunch of records, and we settled back and listened to Louis, and he played nothing but Bobby Hackett records. Well, we sort of hinted that we'd like to hear some of his records.
